title: Zesty Syrian Fish Kebabs
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring fish marinated in a mixture of cumin seeds, mustard, and spices, then double-fried to crispy perfection, served with a side of nostalgia and a hint of Middle Eastern flair.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together cumin seeds, mustard powder, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Cut the fish fillets into bite-sized pieces and place them in a large bowl.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil over the fish pieces, then sprinkle the cumin seed mixture evenly over the top.
Let the fish marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Thread the marinated fish pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.

Double-fry the fish kebabs by first frying them in hot oil at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 2-3 minutes on each side, then finishing them in the oven for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the Zesty Syrian Fish Kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a side of your favorite tahini sauce.
Traditionally, these kebabs are served with a side of pickled turnips and a dollop of creamy hummus.
